### Judah Repents
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judah-repents
Passage: Genesis 38:20-26
Points:
- Scripture places the primary blame on Judah rather than Tamar for her desperate measures.
- Judah was initially motivated by fear of public disgrace rather than genuine grief over his sin.
- He judged Tamar with severe hypocrisy while excusing his own failure to provide her a husband.
- Tamar acted with daring faith to secure descendants within the covenant family line.
- When convicted of sin, believers must follow Judah's example of honest confession and repentance.
